notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.96

Fixed: lines older than about a year were dropped. A statement going back to 2024 lost its older invoices, and they became a “balance brought forward” that couldn’t be checked. Every line is now kept, however old (up to 10 years back).
Dates printed month first (09/20/2024) are read that way when the statement uses that order, so 06/11/2025 is 11 June, not 6 November. “Cust No” is recognised as the customer number, and when no closing balance is labelled, the last running balance is used.
Upload the same statement again to pick up lines an earlier reading missed. They are added, the statement’s dates widen to cover the first line, the opening balance is read again, and the statement is compared with QuickBooks over the whole period.
